description: AICTIONBOT™ capability check by KULIC Advisory, built on the Execution Toolkit templates T16 (competency assessment), T17 (team assessment) and T18 (capability matrix). Takes people with role and self or manager ratings 1 to 5 for ten procurement capabilities (need, market, tender, nego, contract, srm, spend, p2p, risk, stake) or for the user's own profile, compares them with the target per role (buyer, category manager, procurement business partner, S2P lead; suggested targets marked as such) and returns per person the average gap, the largest gaps and a verdict (ready for a stretch role, develop selectively, coaching plan), plus three training priorities for the team and a 30, 60, 90 day path. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

people.description: Rows: name (or role label), role, scores {need, market, tender, nego, contract, srm, spend, p2p, risk, stake} each 1 to 5.

profile.description: Optional own profile: capability and target level 1 to 5; scores then use the capability names as keys.
